blocks.text: Cloverdale houses by price band, September 2026

32 houses sold in September against 201 listed. The price band with the most sales was $1,000,001 to $1,250,000, with 18 sold (56% of the month). Among bands with at least ten homes listed, the highest sales ratio was $1,000,001 to $1,250,000 at 29%.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Cloverdale?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 201 houses listed in Cloverdale and 32 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 16%. Month-end counts move daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: What is the reported sale price for houses in Cloverdale?
faq.a: The September report gave $1,212,500 for houses in Cloverdale, against $1,258,000 the month before. The reports give one sale-price figure and do not say whether it is an average or a median, so use it for direction, not as a valuation of your own home.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Cloverdale?
faq.a: The September report showed 19 days on market for houses in Cloverdale and a sale-to-list price ratio of 98%, against 19 days the month before.

faq.q: Do I need a home inspection when buying in Cloverdale?
faq.a: It is strongly recommended. Make the offer subject to an inspection so a qualified inspector can look at the roof, structure, drainage, electrical and heating before you remove conditions.

faq.q: Can I add a suite or coach house to a house in Cloverdale?
faq.a: BC's small-scale multi-unit housing rules allow more homes on many urban lots, but each municipality sets the details and many lots are excluded. Check the lot's zoning with the municipality before you plan a suite or coach house.
